statement: NVIDIA management says it has supply for about 70% of demand and that the entire supply chain is running flat out.
why: When a vendor can only cover part of what customers want, shipments measure supply, not demand.

impact.mechanism: A supply chain running at its limit caps deliverable units and lengthens waits for buyers across the chain.

evidence.source: MarketBeat (Q2 FY2027 earnings call transcript excerpt)
evidence.excerpt: We have supply for 70%. Our demand is much higher than that, and we've got to go work hard.

confidence.basis: Secondary transcript aggregator quoting the call; no primary transcript fetched to corroborate.
